problem_type: 测试与走查启动路径向真实供应商和公开提示词源发出请求
symptom: 带 APIMart 内置档案的走查打开项目时探测真实 api.apimart.ai/models；提示词库启动时读取 raw.githubusercontent.com
direct_cause: 夹具只替换了供应商服务地址，主进程 appFetch 和提示词库刷新仍接受任意公网 URL；没有测试模式的共享目的地判据
class_root: 测试环境没有在最早共享出站边界强制请求只能去 loopback 或登记的夹具 origin
affected_population: 带内置供应商档案的 UX 走查
调用模型列表探测的测试与连接向导
首次读取提示词库的离线 / CI 测试
entry_points: Chromium 走查资源：walkthrough-network-guard 的 session.webRequest
internal_only_reason: 这是测试环境的内部目的地不变量；仓库已有 Undici、Electron webRequest 和 appFetch，外部文档不能决定本仓夹具登记语义。
invariants: 启用测试网络模式时，主进程 HTTP 请求只能去 loopback 或 NOMI_TEST_NETWORK_FIXTURE_ORIGINS 登记的 origin
登记的真实供应商 origin 必须在发出前改投登记的 loopback 夹具；未登记公网 host 直接失败并带 hostname
测试网络模式下提示词库只读随包 bundled fixture，不启动远端刷新
未启用测试网络模式时，生产请求路径和在线提示词刷新行为保持原样

door_reduction.why_not: appFetch and hardenedFetch are separate shared HTTP owners; their callers cannot be deleted, so both boundaries remain and each fails closed in test mode.

generality_proof: The test-mode predicate is applied at both main-process HTTP owners: appFetch and hardenedFetch. This covers model probes, vendor calls, media retrieval, local probes, and prompt refreshes regardless of proxy or DNS implementation; getPromptLibrary additionally avoids starting remote refresh in test mode.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Parse test-mode fixture origins and fail closed for unregistered public hosts.
Guard the primary main-process HTTP route before dispatch.
Guard the independent hardened retrieval route, including redirects, before proxy or DNS dispatch.
Return bundled prompts without starting remote refresh in test mode.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses appFetch, whose shared guard rejects unregistered public origins.
Uses hardenedFetchText, whose shared guard now rejects unregistered public origins.
Renderer requests remain governed by the existing walkthrough session webRequest guard.

recurrence.reason: 任何新模型供应商、新的只读远端资源或新的 appFetch 调用者都能重新把公网 host 带进测试启动路径。
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs electron/appFetch.ts：25 个主进程 appFetch 门，全部共享同一出口。
git grep -n 'raw.githubusercontent.com' electron/promptLibrary：promptSources 是远端源唯一生产入口，store 只有一个读取门。
Card 25 网络记录：5 次 Electron 走查共 11 次 raw.githubusercontent.com 主进程读取。
D:/Nomi-service/roadmap/TODO.md：model-list and project-open walkthrough records 描述模型列表真实地址探测。

prevention.invariant: When test mode is enabled, every main-process HTTP URL must be loopback or a registered fixture origin, with optional explicit origin redirect to loopback.
prevention.failure_mode: Throw TestNetworkBlockedError naming the hostname before proxy, DNS, or fetch dispatch; prompt library returns bundled prompts.
prevention.strategy: Call the same pure URL guard at each shared main-process HTTP boundary and keep the prompt catalog test-mode branch.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy production path was deleted; the existing prompt library refresh remains the production path and now converges on hardenedFetchText.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: 没有第三方依赖控制这个测试不变量；复用现有 appFetch、Undici 和 Electron webRequest。

migration: 无持久化数据迁移；走查夹具通过环境变量登记 loopback origin，既有生产 catalog 不改写。
residual_risks: Real Card 25 Electron walks were not rerun in this handoff; the new hardenedFetch regression proves the previously unguarded raw GitHub class fails before dispatch.
Renderer Chromium traffic still depends on the walkthrough session webRequest guard and is outside main-process URL ownership.

invariant_owner_layer.why: appFetch is the shared main-process HTTP boundary and its regression tests prove both fail-closed public-host rejection and loopback fixture redirection; prompt catalog has a separate test-mode branch test.
